worldcombat.skill.dragondance.summary: A mystic dance that spirals upward: the user twists in place, climbing turn by turn while dragon aura coils into a rising spiral, raising Attack and Speed. The dragon surge lasts for a visible window, after which the Attack and Speed it raised are taken back.
worldcombat.skill.dragondance.use.0: Build both Attack and Speed before a fight
worldcombat.skill.dragondance.use.1: Spiral once when chased and slip away on the new Speed
worldcombat.skill.dragondance.use.2: Rise and gather power in the window while the foe closes in
worldcombat.skill.dragondance.descriptio: After the wind-up Attack and Speed each rise by %1$s and the user circles %2$s turns.
The dragon surge lasts %1$s and the spiral spans %2$s blocks; when it ends the Attack and Speed it raised are taken back.
worldcombat.skill.dragondance.soar.on: Soaring: every rising beat truly lifts %1$s blocks and the surge window is 20 percent longer, for a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.dragondance.soar.off: Low glide: circling without leaping, quicker to finish, with the regular surge window.
worldcombat.skill.dragondance.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.dragondance.growth.0: At level %1$s the dragon surge stretches to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragondance.growth.1: At level %1$s the dragon surge stretches further to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragondance.preference: On: every rising beat truly lifts off and the surge window is multiplied by 1.2, at the cost of a 3-tick longer wind-up and 12 ticks more cooldown. Off: low glide, quicker to finish.
The move is considered only against a threat within this distance; larger means stacking Attack and Speed earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion attack instead of dancing; larger gives up the buff more often up close.
